title: introduce-credential-telemetry-synthetic-retry-profiles-and-stream-shim-bump
author: Aisha Thompson
release_notes: Adds a small cross-SDK shim that centralizes credential telemetry and lightweight synthetic retry presets; minor SDK version bumps to align ergonomics. No breaking API changes; migration notes included.
description: Motivation: Several production incidents highlighted gaps in credential lifecycle visibility and the difficulty of tuning retry behavior for streaming flows. This PR introduces a compact shim that centralizes credential telemetry (events for lease/refresh/fallback) and exposes lightweight, opinionated synthetic retry profiles that are safe for streaming consumers across Python/TS/Go SDKs. Design: - A thin, language-agnostic contract (credential events + hints) implemented per-SDK with minimal surface area. - Synthetic retry profiles (fast/fallback/graceful) encoded as small presets that map to existing retry builders. - Stream adapter that surfaces credential events to consumers and can opt into automatic soft-retries for recoverable auth transient errors. Checklist: - [x] Implement telemetry hooks in TS/Python/Go SDKs - [x] Add synthetic retry preset mappings and docs - [x] Add end-to-end integration tests (stream replay & token swap) - [x] Update SDK changelogs and bump package versions - [x] Run benchmark lab for small/medium streaming workloads Compatibility notes: - Default behavior preserves current timeouts and does not change backoff shapes unless consumer opts into presets. - Opt-in flags: `enableCredentialTelemetry` and `retryPreset` (values: fast|fallback|graceful). Rollout plan: staged release on package registries and a feature-flagged server-side rollout to enable telemetry ingestion for a subset of customers. Revert strategy: revert the package bumps and server-side flag if telemetry ingestion shows schema issues. Links: linear ENG-8590, ENG-9041; SUP-1123.

review_comments:
Lucas Chen: overall design LGTM. Two asks: 1) ensure we don't allocate extra objects on hot path in TS stream reads; 2) add a short perf test for the fast preset.
Author reply (Aisha): addressed both — removed transient allocations in the stream loop and added microbenchmarks under benchmarks/streaming.

Marta Gomez: Python shim looks good, but async iterator semantics need explicit close/handoff.
Author reply (Aisha): added __aenter__/__aexit__ and explicit close in tests; documented behavior in docs/sdk/credential-telemetry.md.

Ravi Kapoor: Can the Go shim reuse existing tracing context? Also requested a unit to validate payload sizes.
Author reply (Aisha): yes — shim now accepts a context.Context and reuses trace/span; added a unit test that asserts payload < 8KB to protect ingestion pipeline.
notes_for_consumers: Consumers who want increased visibility can flip `enableCredentialTelemetry=true`. If you enable telemetry and observe unexpected auth churn, set `retryPreset=fallback` to prefer conservative retrying. No immediate changes required for existing consumers.
backport_recommendation: cherry-pick to release/1.28.x only if you need telemetry in an emergency; synthetic retry presets are opinionated so backport cautiously.
